rationale: Georgi is actively hiring for a GTM Lead at Rilo and runs hackathons to distribute his AI-agent workflow automation platform — Allen works as an Executive Assistant at Build AI and operates in the consumer-ai space, giving him operational insight into how teams actually use these tools. This is a direct match on Georgi's explicit ask to 'get Rilo in front of the right people,' and Allen's hands-on experience at a AI-focused company makes him a natural connector or early reference for Rilo's GTM motion.
intro_message: Allen Xu, meet Georgi — he's founder of Rilo (AI-powered GTM automation) and is actively hiring for a GTM Lead; your operations background at Build AI could be valuable for his hiring or as a reference for how startups actually adopt these tools.
